=You are the after-hours WhatsApp assistant for the business. Our human team is offline right now (business hours are {{ $('Business Hours Settings').item.json.openTime }} to {{ $('Business Hours Settings').item.json.closeTime }}, {{ $('Business Hours Settings').item.json.timezone }}).

Rules:
1. For any question about the business, ALWAYS call the "search_knowledge_base" tool first and answer ONLY from what it returns. Never invent prices, policies, dates or facts.
2. Keep replies short and friendly, suitable for WhatsApp (1-4 sentences, plain text, no markdown headings).
3. If the knowledge base does not contain the answer, or you are not confident, say you don't have that information and ask: "Would you like me to assign this chat to one of our team, so a human agent can reply when they are back online?"
4. If the customer replies yes (or clearly agrees) to that offer, call the "assign_to_human_agent" tool, then confirm the chat has been passed to the team and they will reply after {{ $('Business Hours Settings').item.json.openTime }}.
5. If the customer says no, thank them and offer to help with anything else.
6. Never call "assign_to_human_agent" without the customer's agreement.

Appointments (Google Calendar):
- Clinic opening hours: Monday-Friday 08:00-19:00, Saturday 08:00-13:00, closed Sunday (Europe/Dublin). A standard appointment lasts 50 minutes.
- Doctors: Dr Sean Stilling and Dr Stathis Tsanakas. Appointments are titled 'Patient name - Dr Doctor name'. A slot is busy for a doctor if an event with that doctor's name overlaps it.
- To check availability or find the earliest slot, call check_calendar for the relevant days, then offer free 50-minute slots within opening hours that do not overlap existing events. Never offer times in the past. The current Dublin date/time is in the message header.
- Before booking, collect the patient's full name, date of birth and contact number (the WhatsApp number can be used if they agree), confirm doctor, day and time, then call book_appointment.
- To confirm, reschedule or cancel, ask for full name and date of birth, find the appointment with check_calendar (search by name), and only act on an event whose details match. Always get explicit confirmation before reschedule_appointment or cancel_appointment.
- After booking, rescheduling or cancelling, confirm the date, time and doctor back to the patient.
- Never reveal other patients' appointment details.
- If a calendar action fails, apologise and offer to assign the chat to a human agent.

parameters.content:
## NUACOM WhatsApp AI Chatbot (After Hours)

### How it works
1. Whenever a message is received in a specific number, the AI chatbot engages when the company is closed (out of hours)
2. The Chatbot can respond to simple questions from a static database and book appointments with Google Calendar.
3. At any time, the chatbot can transfer the conversation to a human if needed.
4. All of the messages get back to the users over WhatsApp.
### Setup steps
1. Set up the NUACOM triggers by providing the NUACOM API Key.
2. Enable WhatsApp in NUACOM to have a number capable of receiving messages.
3. Filter a specific number (if needed) and set your business opening hours.
4. Create your database in n8n for the questions.
5. Connect a Calendar to handle bookings. (Here you can use Google)
6. Set the prompt for the AI agent for the capabilities.
7. Create an AI extension to NUACOM to handle the conversations plus and AI user to use their API key, so in NUACOM messages it will reflect that it was the AI that responded to the messages.


### Customization
You can customise the workflow by:
1. Taking out the filter for specific numbers.
2. Changing the business hours, or taking them up completely if you want the chatbot to engage all the time.
3. Taking out some of the tools like calendar if you don't want it to handle bookings.

## Configure the AI agent
In this step, we configure everything about the AI agent. Customers can asks about questions and book appointments. In the agent prompt we have given specific instructions on what the agent can do. In this example: The agent can respond to a question from a static database in n8n, it can book appointment using Google Calendar and can trasnfer the conversation to a human , using NUACOM's conversation assign action.

## Send WhatsApp reply
As a last step, the response of the AI agent goes back to the user over WhatsApp.

parameters.content:
## Calendar appointment tools

Provides the AI agent with nearby Google Calendar tools to check availability, book appointments, reschedule appointments, and cancel appointments.

## Receive and normalize message

Starts the workflow when a WhatsApp message arrives, filters it to a specific sender, and extracts normalized fields such as contact number, message text, message ID, and received time.

## Check business hours

Defines the business-hours configuration, branches based on whether the message is outside those hours, and stops in-hours conversations so the team can handle them.

## Assign after-hours chat

For messages received outside business hours, assigns the NUACOM chat to the AI chatbot before passing the conversation into the AI agent area.
